tourist.greet1: Hi! I heard you fix phones here.
tourist.greet2: Sawasdee! I'm hoping you can save my holiday.
tourist.accept2: Okay, {price} ฿. As long as it works again!
tourist.counter1: Hmm, that's a bit steep… how about {price} ฿?
tourist.refuse1: Nah, at that price I'll keep it broken.
tourist.pickup1: Here I am! Is my phone ready?
tourist.thanks1: Fantastic, thanks a million! Khop khun!

local.greet1: Sawasdee! You're the new one who took over from Lung Somchai?
local.greet2: Hi nong, I've got a little job for you.
local.counter1: For us islanders, make it {price} ฿, come on.
local.refuse1: Too expensive. I'll wait until I go to Phuket.
local.pickup1: I'm back for the phone, is it all sorted?
local.thanks1: Well done! I'll tell everyone at the market.

diver.greet1: Hey! I've got a phone that's seen more sea than I have.
diver.greet2: Hi! Small accident on the boat…
diver.accept1: {price} ฿? Okay, that's cheaper than a tank.
diver.accept2: {price} ฿ works, as long as it resurfaces.
diver.counter1: Let's say {price} ฿ and I'll take you to see the leopard sharks?
diver.refuse1: At that price I'll use it as a dive weight.
diver.pickup1: Back at the surface! How did it go with the phone?
diver.thanks1: Awesome! I promise I'll use the waterproof case. Maybe.

backpacker.greet1: Hi… please tell me it's cheap.
backpacker.greet2: Hey! I've got a phone in bad shape and a budget in worse shape.
backpacker.accept2: Fine, {price} ฿. I need it for the maps!
backpacker.counter1: I've only got {price} ฿ until the next ATM…
backpacker.refuse1: No way, that's three days of hostel budget.
backpacker.pickup1: I'm here for the phone! Does it work?
backpacker.thanks1: You're a legend! Five stars as soon as I find Wi-Fi.

business.greet1: Good morning. I have little time and a phone that's out of action.
business.greet2: Hello. I need a repair done properly, and done now.
business.accept2: Very well, {price} ฿. I'll need a receipt.
business.counter1: I'm offering {price} ฿. Take it or leave it.
business.refuse1: Out of the question. Good day.
business.pickup1: I'm here to collect. I trust everything is in order.
business.thanks1: Excellent work. I'll recommend you to my colleagues.

any.urgent_today1: I need it by sunset, I've got a ferry to catch!
any.urgent_today2: I'm leaving tonight: can you manage it by six?
any.urgent_wait1: Can I wait here? I feel lost without my phone.
any.urgent_wait2: I'll sit in the shade and wait, if you won't be too long.
any.urgent_normal1: No rush, I'll swing by tomorrow.
any.urgent_normal2: I'll leave it with you and pick it up tomorrow.
any.ripoff1: What?! I could buy a new one for that! Goodbye.
any.ripoff2: That's daylight robbery. I'm telling everyone.
any.impatient1: Oh well, I can see you're busy. I'll come back another time.
any.impatient2: I've been waiting forever… I'm off.
any.pickup_late1: What do you mean “it's not ready”? I'll wait a bit longer, but hurry up.
any.pickup_late2: We agreed on now… I'll give you a few minutes.
any.angry1: Unbelievable. Give me my phone back, I'm leaving.
any.angry2: What a waste of time. I'm never coming back.
any.no_tools1: Oh, you don't have the right gear? Shame, thanks anyway.
any.no_tools2: I see. Thanks for being honest, I'll try somewhere else.
any.rack_full1: Swamped with work, eh? I'll come back.
any.meh1: Meh. Here's {price} ฿. Let's say it works.
any.meh2: Not quite what I was hoping for. Here, {price} ฿.
any.postpone1: All right, I'll come back tomorrow. But it had better be ready!

noi.name: Noi
noi.role: Owner of the bar next door
noi.greet1: Sawasdee kha! I brought you a mango smoothie… and a broken phone.
noi.greet2: Neighbour! The bar's phone is acting up again.
noi.greet3: Hi sweetie, got five minutes for your favourite neighbour?
noi.accept1: {price} ฿? Fine, and tonight the Chang is on me.
noi.thanks1: You're almost as good as Lung Somchai! Almost.
noi.thanks2: Khop khun kha! I'm telling everyone at the bar to come to you.

kai.name: Kai
kai.greet1: Brother! You'll never guess what happened… okay, you will: it fell in the water.
kai.greet2: Here I am again. The sea gives, the sea takes away. This time it took my phone.
kai.greet3: Twelve metres down. Twelve! And it still has a little light on.
kai.accept1: {price} ฿, done. At this point I'm paying your rent.
kai.pickup1: Is it alive? Tell me it's alive.
kai.thanks1: You're my hero. See you next week, probably.
kai.thanks2: Awesome! I swear I'll buy the waterproof case. I swear.

matteo.name: Matteo
matteo.greet1: Ciao, ciao! Finally, someone I can talk to about serious things. Like: my phone is broken.
matteo.greet2: Ehi, bello! I'm still here, I was supposed to leave three weeks ago. Look at this disaster.
matteo.greet3: Ciao, boss! My mamma hasn't heard from me in two days, she's about to call the embassy.
matteo.accept1: {price} ฿… mamma mia. Okay, fine, I'll live on pad thai.
matteo.pickup1: So, dottore, how is the patient?
matteo.thanks1: Grande! I'll buy you a coffee. I mean, when I find a real coffee.
matteo.thanks2: You're a genius. I might just stay another month.
